tips.hardcoded_origin: This crashed outside hxscript, so it is probably engine/source code or a compiled library path.
tips.first_source_line: Check the first source line in the stack before the engine loop; that is usually the useful culprit.
tips.rebuild_assets: If this only happens after editing scripts/classes, rebuild and make sure the exported assets are not stale.
tips.native_crash: This is a native/critical crash path, so the app could not recover cleanly.
tips.close_running_build: If this appeared during build testing, close every running PlusEngine.exe before rebuilding.
tips.disable_mod_scripts: If mods are enabled, retry with scripts disabled to separate engine crashes from mod-side crashes.
